exposure: needle-beside-needle (NBN) technique for combined epidural/spinal anesthesia
traditional needle-through-needle (NTN) technique for combined epidural/spinal anesthesia
outcome: duration from spinal injection to returning patients to supine position
cohort: Parturients scheduled for elective cesarean section
finding: The NBN technique for combined epidural/spinal anesthesia during cesarean section resulted in less procedure time, shorter duration from spinal injection to supine position, and higher anesthetist satisfaction compared to the traditional NTN technique.
